ISO currency codes

Source: R/data.R
isocurrency.Rd

ISO 4217 currency codes (list one) with the number of minor units and the countries using each currency. Country names and codes are taken from isocountry.

Usage

isocurrency

Format

A data frame with 262 rows and 7 variables:

currency_name

ISO currency name

currency_code

ISO 4217 alphabetic code, e.g. "AFN"

currency_number

ISO 4217 numeric code, e.g. "971"

currency_minor_unit

number of digits after the decimal separator

country_name

ISO country name

country_code

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "AF"

country_number

ISO 3166-1 numeric code, e.g. "004"

Source

Published free of charge by SIX, the ISO 4217 maintenance agency, at https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information/data-standards.html. ISO permits free use of the ISO 4217 currency codes.

See also

isocurrency_historic for withdrawn currencies.

Examples

head(isocurrency)
#>    currency_name currency_code currency_number currency_minor_unit
#> 1        Afghani           AFN             971                   2
#> 2           Euro           EUR             978                   2
#> 3            Lek           ALL             008                   2
#> 4 Algerian Dinar           DZD             012                   2
#> 5      US Dollar           USD             840                   2
#> 6           Euro           EUR             978                   2
#>     country_name country_code country_number
#> 1    Afghanistan           AF            004
#> 2  Åland Islands           AX            248
#> 3        Albania           AL            008
#> 4        Algeria           DZ            012
#> 5 American Samoa           AS            016
#> 6        Andorra           AD            020
